decisions.title: Require a shared final-report contract across installed agent integrations
decisions.decision: After meaningful work, installed agents should run flow release when relevant and report doctor status, wiki lint status, suspect or low-confidence areas, repair queue state, routing bundle path, PR summary path, metrics path, and estimated token savings when metrics are available.
decisions.why: A shared final-report contract keeps Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and custom agents aligned on the same health and trust signals instead of leaving metrics and routing outcomes implicit.
